subject: Onsite workshop — arrival clearance, badge flow, and liaison details
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@horizonadvisors.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <m.singh@horizonadvisors.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final logistics for Sept 22 exec workshop — badges & escorts

Hi Priya / Monica,

Thanks again for confirming the Sept 22 executive workshop at Horizon HQ. A few operational items security needs nailed down before we can clear the guest list: 

- Pre-registered badge CSV (name, company, DOB, government ID last 4 digits)
- Point-of-contact for on-site escorts and any attendees who need unescorted access exceptions
- Whether guests will bring corporate laptops or need loaner machines from our AV team

I've attached our building badge requirements (pdf) — in short: everyone needs a government ID at check-in; contractors/consultants require sponsor validation and a temporary badge that must be returned at exit.

Can you confirm attendee list and whether Redwood will require full building access or escorted-only movement in secure zones? Also, parking passes for three vehicles would be helpful.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Events & Facilities
Horizon Advisors

Attachments: horizon-badge-requirements.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@horizonadvisors.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final logistics for Sept 22 exec workshop — badges & escorts

Laura — thanks for the note and the doc. We're targeting a small exec delegation + product team: 8 people total. High level answers below and attached is an updated attendee CSV.

- Badge flow (preferred):
  1) Pre-register names to security (CSV) 24 hours before event.
  2) Guests check in at main lobby desk; security verifies government ID + photo match.
  3) Issue temporary visitor badge (orange lanyard) with escort requirement flagged for any non-Roadmap staff.
  4) Team lead (Vivek) will escort executives to meeting room and break area until badges are cleared for limited access.

- Access level: most attendees should be escorted-only; two senior execs (Vivek, Rishi) will need broader floor access for quick walk-throughs.
- Laptops: Redwood will bring company laptops with full disk encryption. We do NOT plan to bring external drives.
- Parking: yes please — three passes for Lot B.

If Horizon requires NDAs or a signed access agreement, send the DocuSign link and we'll push it to attendees immediately.

Timeline: our team arrives by 08:30, will be at security desk by 08:45 for badge pickup; meeting starts at 09:30.

Attendees (attached): redwood_attendee_list_v2.csv

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_attendee_list_v2.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final logistics for Sept 22 exec workshop — badges & escorts

Quick note: we'll bring two company laptops and one demo machine preloaded with the latest serving telemetry (no external HDDs).

Question for Laura: does Horizon require device inventory at check-in (serials) or just model/owner? If serials are required we'll add that to the CSV.

Also looping Rishi to confirm which execs need floor access and whether we should prepare an alternate meeting room in case of AV restrictions.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@horizonadvisors.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Singh <m.singh@horizonadvisors.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final logistics for Sept 22 exec workshop — badges & escorts

Thanks Priya — that plan works. A few items from security and legal: 

- NDA: We require a signed site-entry NDA for any attendee with floor access. I've created a DocuSign envelope and added the two execs who requested floor access. Link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123456789
- ID policy: government ID at check-in is mandatory. For guests who cannot present an ID, security permits manager-signed temporary badges that restrict movement to conference areas only (no server room, no executive floor).
- Device inventory: we only need model + last 4 of serial number for demo gear; full serials are not necessary unless device will remain on site overnight.
- Escorting: Maya Singh (Facilities) will be your primary on-site liaison and escort for all non-floor movements. She will meet you at the security desk at 08:45.
- Photographer/press: if you plan to have any on-site photography, we need to approve shot list ahead of time. No photos in the secure lab area.

I've attached the floor plan for the 12th floor and the building access checklist.

See you on the 22nd — I'll confirm parking pass codes once security finalizes them later this week.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Events & Facilities
Horizon Advisors

Attachments: onsite-floorplan.png
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@horizonadvisors.com>, Maya Singh <m.singh@horizonadvisors.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final logistics for Sept 22 exec workshop — badges & escorts

Appreciate the clarity, Laura — that's all good on our side. Final confirmations: 

- We've completed the DocuSign NDA for the two execs with floor access.
- Updated attendee CSV includes device model + last 4 serial digits where applicable.
- Redwood will bring encrypted company laptops and will not leave devices overnight.
- Arrival window: entire Redwood delegation will be at the lobby desk by 08:45 for badge pickup and Maya will meet us there.

Fallback if an attendee forgets ID: provide manager-signed temporary badge + escort limited to conference rooms and public break area. Please confirm who at Horizon will be the authorized manager contact for temporary badge approval (name & desk extension).

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth visit.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
